description: DOCS: return the full text of one RateAPI documentation page by slug (from search_docs) or by its published URL. Documentation only — it describes the contract, not live rates. Available slugs: quickstart, authentication, rate-limits-and-pricing, coverage, freshness, evidence-and-methodology, quoting-rules, eligibility, endpoints, mcp-server, products-and-parameters, errors-and-troubleshooting, deprecation-policy.

slug.description: The page identifier returned by search_docs.

url.description: Alternatively, the canonical published URL of the page.

name: get_doc

available.description: Valid slugs, returned alongside an error.

content.description: Full page text in markdown, ending with its source URL.

error.description: Present when no page matched the reference given.
